source: CEC candidate files, info.cec.gov.tw/vote2026/static/json/cand/T/<county code>.json, read 2026-11-11. 臺南市's file was not published (404); its districts are taken from 2022 until it is.
note: electors_est: the 2022 district's electors where the district and its towns are unchanged; otherwise the 2022 electors of its towns (regional seats; an overestimate where a district takes part of a town) or the largest 2022 district of the same indigenous type in the county. Used only as an upper bound on the votes still out.
